messages.content:
4 people (Ada, Hugo, Esme, Bram) sit in a row of 4 seats numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. All of the following are true:

1. Esme does not sit in seat 3.
2. Ada sits in seat 4.
3. Ada and Hugo sit next to each other.
4. Esme and Hugo do not sit next to each other.
5. Esme sits somewhere to the left of Bram.
6. Hugo sits somewhere to the left of Ada.

Who sits where?

Give the names in seat order from seat 1 to the last seat, separated by commas.
Reason as much as you like, then finish with one final line of the form
ANSWER: <your answer>

content.text:
Seat1: Esme, Seat2: Bram, Seat3: Hugo, Seat4: Ada

Check: Esme not seat3 ✓; Ada seat4 ✓; Ada-Hugo adjacent (3,4) ✓; Esme-Hugo (1,3) not adjacent ✓; Esme(1) left of Bram(2) ✓; Hugo(3) left of Ada(4) ✓.
